envelope.description: Chat host feeds declarations and shows the outcome

body.title: Chat host feeds declarations and shows the outcome
body.summary: In chat-panel.ts pass each tool-call event's present list to the presented turn's declared() on both feed paths (the followed live turn and the hosted run) with the existing guarded helpers, and show the DeclaredOutcome as chat information lines (a name that is not pending, an unreadable pending list). extension.ts keeps building the presenter as today.
acceptanceChecks: A tool-call's declared documents reach the presenter on both a followed live turn and a hosted run, and nothing else is passed
A not-pending name and an unreadable pending list each show an information line in the chat
The chat opens a declared pending document even when the insrc_present call itself failed

tests.name: the chat host passes a tool-call's declared documents to the presenter and nothing else, and ends the turn without opening anything
the chat host shows a line for a not-pending name and for an unreadable pending list from the presenter's outcome
the chat host feeds the declaration from both a followed live turn and a hosted run
the chat opens a declared pending document even when the insrc_present tool call itself failed
